result.instructions: Tools for Discord, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which channels does our Discord server have, and which ones are for support?"; "Show the last 50 messages in #announcements."; "Reply in #general that the release is delayed until Friday.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Discord data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run discord_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run discord_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run discord_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. discord_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: discord_get_bot_user
tools.title: Get the bot user
tools.description: Return the bot user this server connects as (id, username). Call it first to confirm the token works. Discord API: GET /users/@me.

tools.name: discord_list_guilds
tools.title: List servers
tools.description: List the Discord servers (guilds) the bot is a member of. Use the ids with the other discord_ tools. Discord API: GET /users/@me/guilds.

before.description: Only servers with an id before this one (pagination).

after.description: Only servers with an id after this one (pagination).

with_counts.description: Include approximate member and online counts.

tools.name: discord_get_guild
tools.title: Get a server
tools.description: Get one server by id: name, owner, features, and optionally approximate member counts. Discord API: GET /guilds/{guild_id}.

with_counts.description: Include approximate member and online counts.

tools.name: discord_list_guild_channels
tools.title: List server channels
tools.description: List the channels of one server (text, voice, categories, forums). Threads are not included. Discord API: GET /guilds/{guild_id}/channels.

tools.name: discord_get_channel
tools.title: Get a channel
tools.description: Get one channel or thread by id: type, name, parent, topic. Discord API: GET /channels/{channel_id}.

tools.name: discord_list_messages
tools.title: List messages
tools.description: List recent messages in a channel, newest first. Use before, after, or around to page; pass only one of them. Message text is empty unless the bot has the MESSAGE_CONTENT intent. Discord API: GET /channels/{channel_id}/messages.

before.description: Only messages before this message id.

after.description: Only messages after this message id.

tools.name: discord_get_message
tools.title: Get a message
tools.description: Get one message by id in a channel, with its author, text, embeds, and reactions. Discord API: GET /channels/{channel_id}/messages/{message_id}.

tools.name: discord_list_pinned_messages
tools.title: List pinned messages
tools.description: List the pinned messages of a channel, with the time each was pinned. Discord API: GET /channels/{channel_id}/messages/pins.

before.description: Pagination cursor: the pinned_at timestamp of the last pin you received.

tools.name: discord_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get a public user object by id (username, global name, avatar, bot flag). No email or private data. Discord API: GET /users/{user_id}.

user_id.description: The user id (for example the author id of a message).

tools.name: discord_send_message
tools.title: Send a message
tools.description: Post a text message to a channel as the bot. Visible to everyone in the channel. Mentions do not ping @everyone or roles. Optionally reply to a message. Discord API: POST /channels/{channel_id}/messages.

channel_id.description: The channel id to post in.

reply_to_message_id.description: Reply to this message id in the same channel.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Discord
prompts.description: What you can do with Discord here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: read_recent_messages_in_a_channel
prompts.title: Read recent messages in a channel
prompts.description: List the recent messages of a channel, newest first, and open one message. Message text is empty unless the bot has the message content intent.

prompts.name: map_servers_and_channels
prompts.title: Map servers and channels
prompts.description: List the servers the bot is in, then the channels of one server. Read the type, topic and parent of one channel.

prompts.name: read_pinned_messages
prompts.title: Read pinned messages
prompts.description: List the pinned messages of a channel, with the time each one was pinned.

prompts.name: look_up_a_public_user_profile
prompts.title: Look up a public user profile
prompts.description: Read the public profile of a user by id: username, global name, avatar and bot flag. No private data is returned.

prompts.name: post_a_message_as_the_bot
prompts.title: Post a message as the bot
prompts.description: Post a text message to a channel, or reply to a message in the same channel. Mentions do not ping everyone or roles.
